content.title: Oscars 2026: Ryan Coogler wins for best original screenplay
content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more 139,218 views • Mar 15, 2026 Ryan Coogler won the Oscar for best original screen play for "Sinners" ...more ...more 271 Comments Add a comment... As an Irish man im delighted Ryan won,he brought one of our folk songs to the world. He left the NFL to chase his dream to be a filmmaker. We all can make our dreams come true! Michael B. Jordan and Ryan Coogler show that success can happen when two friends are willing to work together as great partners. Ryan never saw Michael as just a waiter who is there to serve the screenplay like Steven Spielberg does. When Sinners came out... opening night first show 70mm IMAX @ CityWalk... he was there with his wife and the third producer. He spoke to our audience. I appreciated that so much. So happy he won this award... that film was recognised for something special. I ended up watching it in the ultra RARE format of 70mm 5perf @ the Vista. And again in 70mm IMAX.... what a crowning achievement for the whole crew. Read more that speech was beautiful wow, what a man. I don’t know if the average person sits back and marvels at what Coogler’s done. Winner for best ORIGINAL screenplay is a momentous feat to achieve. He was able to tell a story in a fresh way that actually resonated with audiences. It’s all about the storytelling. This film is really special. congrats Ryan what an amazing last line, holy shit, that hits! Well deserved. They got this one right! Congrats and looking forward to how you move about the cabin for your next project. I'm in tears I'm not even a black American but as a black person in general i love to see good black people WIN🥹 Being a 46 years old Black man, I have not for years cared if our people, Black people, won an Oscar award, yet I wanted the brother Ryan to win an Oscar. Salute and congratulations to Ryan.
